meta.name: Chief of War
meta.description: With Hawaii's four kingdoms divided by war, the ferocious warrior Kaʻiana embarks on an epic mission to unite his people—as an existential threat approaches their shores.

videos.title: The Chief of War
videos.overview: Kaʻiana is summoned back home to Maui where he must decide whether to join King Kahekili in war.

videos.title: Changing Tides
videos.overview: Fearing for their lives, Kaʻiana and his family flee O‘ahu. An ally emerges with a promise of safe passage.

videos.title: City of Flowers
videos.overview: Kaʻiana arrives in a strange land. Kaʻahumanu takes her place beside Kamehameha.

videos.title: City of Flowers (2)
videos.overview: A dangerous power struggle emerges in the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi. Kamehameha wrestles with his new responsibility. Kaʻiana searches for Tony.

videos.title: The Race of the Gods
videos.overview: Kaʻiana returns with a warning, and a dangerous competition will determine his fate in Kamehameha's council. Keōua sends a message.

videos.title: The Splintered Paddle
videos.overview: Kūpuohi tries to keep the hope of peace alive as the drums of war grow louder. Kaʻiana questions Kamehameha's leadership.

videos.title: Day of Spilled Brains
videos.overview: A disagreement erupts about how to deal with the arrival of outsiders.

videos.title: The Sacred Niu Grove
videos.overview: After his worst fears come true, Kaʻiana suffers a devastating loss. Keōua's call to war becomes unavoidable for Kamehameha.

videos.title: The Black Desert
videos.overview: A great battle arrives as Kaʻiana and Kamehameha lead their army against the combined might of Maui and Keōua.

meta.slogan: Divided islands. War on the horizon.
